policy: shipped dict28.c four-probe FIFO chains (evict tail when chain reaches PROBES=4)
lambda_rule: lambda_b = S / 2^128: the v36 store addresses the FULL 128-bit slot through a radix tree of h = ceil(128/D28_DB) = 6 levels, node = 2^22 x 8 B = 32 MiB <= SIZE_MAX, every allocation <= SIZE_MAX (evidence/bounds36.json). v35's 2^126 heads and its lambda 1.1262 are WITHDRAWN: that layout needs a 2^63 x 8 B = 2^66 B calloc, which does not fit the stated 64-bit ABI.

retention.delta_explanation: 1-P(Poisson(lambda)>=5) is the terminal-size limit for an insertion-only bucket; the shipped chain evicts during fill as well, so the measured loss is larger. Both are reported; the LOWER of the two is used.

kappa_detect_within.definition: P(a WITHIN-TRAIL pair is detected): the planted record is an earlier record of the arriving record's own trail (lag < 64), so this is the class v35 discarded.

kappa_detect_pooled.rule: pooled over BOTH classes; the classes partition the pairs, so no pair is counted twice

kappa_detect.definition: P(true cross-trail key collision is DETECTED) = P(the earlier record is resident and the shipped dict28_wide_lookup returns its reference at the later arrival). Injected-collision control: uniformly chosen earlier key replayed through the shipped lookup.

success_debit.kappa_lower_rule: the MINIMUM of the two class lower bounds (cross, within), each at 3 sigma; the detection debit is the worse class, not the pooled average

wrong_lambda_control.note: the v34 lambda is not instantiable by the shipped u64 store (the v34 head count); the arm is not run there because no bucket count of that size can be initialised
